evaluation: Test portions only. No training or validation rows contribute to reported metrics.
model: The exact same saved validation-selected checkpoint is used for every dataset and the pooled test set. No all-data refit.
checks: Model artifact/report and validation epoch agree.
Shared gene/transcript and mixture groups never cross partitions.
Original labels and prediction hashes verified.
Full-file test scores agree with checkpoint held-out scores.
Pooled metrics concatenate test rows only, preserving sample identity.
limitations: These source datasets were previously explored, so results remain exploratory rather than fresh external validation.
Dataset2 position grouping assumes shared biological sites; cross-dataset gene/read provenance is incomplete.
